title: tools: add native C++ desktop launcher (no console flash)
body:
## What

A 36-line single-file Win32 C++ launcher (`tools/kivun-launcher/`) that double-click-starts Kivun Terminal with **zero console-window flash**. Compiles to a ~100 KB GUI-subsystem exe with Visual Studio's `cl.exe` (or mingw-w64 cross-compile from WSL).

## Why

Today the desktop shortcut chain is:

```
Kivun Terminal.lnk → kivun-terminal.bat → wsl.exe → bash → konsole
```

That works, but a black `cmd.exe` window briefly flashes before WSL takes over. The two common workarounds both have downsides:

| | `.bat` | `.vbs` | **this exe** |
|---|---|---|---|
| Console flash | yes (~0.5s) | no | no |
| Errors visible | yes (in console) | **silent failure** | **MessageBox popup** |
| SmartScreen / AV warnings | rare | sometimes flagged | rare (native exe) |
| Custom icon | no (cmd icon) | no | yes (via `.rc` file) |

## How

`CreateProcessW` on `wsl.exe -d Ubuntu-24.04 /home/<user>/.local/bin/kivun-start.sh` with `DETACHED_PROCESS | CREATE_NO_WINDOW` and `STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW + SW_HIDE`. Returns immediately. The bash launcher inside WSL `exec`s into Konsole, so wsl.exe stays alive (hidden) parenting Konsole until the user closes the window.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `tools/kivun-launcher/kivun-launcher.cpp` | Single-file source (36 lines incl. comments) |
| `tools/kivun-launcher/build.bat` | One-line build via vcvars64 + cl.exe |
| `tools/kivun-launcher/README.md` | Rationale, build instructions, integration notes |
| `tools/kivun-launcher/.gitignore` | Excludes `*.exe` / `*.obj` build artifacts |

**Build artifacts deliberately not committed** — repo stays text-only. CI can build the exe on tag push (`windows-latest` GitHub Actions runners have VS 2022 build tools pre-installed; build is ~5 seconds).

## Status

This is **optional, additive**. Does NOT modify `installer/Kivun_Terminal_Setup.nsi`, `linux/install.sh`, `payload/`, or any default install path. The current `.bat` shortcut keeps working.

Two integration options for the maintainer:

1. **Leave as-is** — community-contributed alternative that users can build manually. README explains the wiring.
2. **Adopt as default** — add an Actions step to `build-windows.yml` that builds `KivunTerminal.exe` and packages it into the NSIS installer in place of the current `.bat` shortcut target. Bigger change, biggest UX win.

Happy to do the NSIS wiring in a follow-up PR if you want option 2.

## Limitations (called out in tools/kivun-launcher/README.md)

- Distro name `Ubuntu-24.04` is currently a string literal in the .cpp. A future revision could read it from `%LOCALAPPDATA%\\Kivun-WSL\\config.txt` via `GetPrivateProfileStringW`.
- User home path inside `kivun-start.sh` is hardcoded — same fix applies.
- No icon embedded yet. Add via `windres` and a `.rc` file pointing to `installer/kivun_icon.ico` for branded taskbar.

## Tested on

- Windows 11 Build 26200.8246
- WSL 2 with Ubuntu-24.04
- WSLg + Konsole 23.08.5
- Visual Studio 2022 Professional (MSVC 14.44)

## Related

Came out of debugging the `.vbs` silent-failure path while setting up Konsole on WSLg from scratch (no NSIS installer used). Full thread context: https://ampcode.com/threads/T-019e0881-d1d1-701d-a174-0e35c613c3aa
